fanin_declared_open_items.my_reasoning: All seven slots carry the explicit unfilled placeholder and the typed status is present. Omega-1 O1-C06's acceptance operates under the warrant, and the source-free freeze is upstream of issuance. No O1-C01..C05 closure depends on a locator. I found no path or locator anywhere in the packet.

I independently determined the binding is CORRECT and UNIQUE. pre553_route_b_production.py is the only module in the whole 330-file rawlsing_next tree declaring PYAT_M01_ROUTE_B_PRODUCTION_COMPOSITOR@1.0.0 and the only module defining execute_route_b_production, and it composes exactly the governed PRE553 owners the planned full LiTS route needs. What remains for HQ is confirmation, not repair. The fan-in's own labelling as fan-in-observed rather than C4B-frozen was the conservative and correct disclosure.

fanin_declared_open_items.my_classification: BLOCKS_LIVE_EXECUTION_ONLY (elevated from the fan-in's ADVISORY; see R7)
fanin_declared_open_items.my_reasoning: I independently confirmed zero lock files of any kind in the repository. That part of the fan-in's disclosure is accurate. But I found three further non-durability facts the fan-in did not disclose, which together mean the O1-C05 execution surface is not reconstructible from the repository. Elevating this from a one-line ADVISORY to a live-execution precondition is warranted. It does not block the freeze, because the freeze's own invalidation law already requires STOP and re-qualification on any runtime change.

The interpreter that actually executed was /…/c4c3-env/bin/python resolving to the cpython-3.11.3-macos-x86_64-none standalone with version string '3.11.3 (main, May 7 2023, 19:01:25) [Clang 16.0.3]' and a recorded base-interpreter SHA-256 prefix. So the commission's requirement to verify an actually-executing interpreter rather than a zero-byte PATH entry is genuinely met. Note the same durability caveat as R7 attaches to that binary.

Correctly scoped by the fan-in, and slightly under-stated in its favour. The 3,404,445,161-byte checkpoint document WAS verified on NoviyMac by D2P with identity_gate PASS, observed_sha256 equal to required_sha256 on a freshly streamed hash of the exact bytes. It is open only against StarriyMac custody, where it is structurally impossible by commission direction.

D2P accepted this at B002 grain by an explicit ruling, on the basis that B002's missing evidence was per-object authority binding plus full snapshot enumeration, not portable storage of all response provenance. Each withheld member carries an exact retained canonical SHA-256, byte length and item count so the bytes are reconstructible from the verified checkpoint.

Structurally impossible on StarriyMac because the checkpoint document is absent there; D2P states the script could not be re-executed without the checkpoint. Open against NoviyMac custody. D2P did independently review the extraction script for ambiguous reconstruction steps and prohibited surfaces and found none.

D2P's own 01_CHECKPOINT_IDENTITY.json records both checkpoint_identity and canonical_closure_identity as NOT_VERIFIED_HERE, with the note that no field carrying either identity was located in the permitted retained material scanned. D2P's requirements_on_HQ_at_fanin instructs in writing: bind the two as OPEN items, do not read them as verified. The fan-in preserved them as labels. additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.title: Route-B producer public API recorded incompletely
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.finding: The freeze records the Route-B producer's key types as RouteBProductionError, I03ExecutionRequest, RouteBEmpiricalObjectGraph and RouteBProductionResult. All four are genuinely in the module's __all__. However the two actual entry points, execute_route_b_production and verify_route_b_replay_receipt, are omitted. O1-C01 requires recording the Route-B producer and the public APIs.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.repair: Record execute_route_b_production and verify_route_b_replay_receipt as the Route-B producer's public API surface.

additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.title: Fan-in bound the Route-B producer while simultaneously asserting a 21-module C4 import closure that excludes it
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.finding: Artifact 02 binds rawlsing_next/pre553_route_b_production.py as the Route-B execution owner and, in the same artifact, reports c4_import_closure_modules = 21 citing C4C3. That 21-module closure does not contain the Route-B producer. The fan-in never reconciled these two statements, so its P2X-exclusion holding was asserted for a surface that excludes a component it had just bound.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.my_independent_resolution: I recomputed the static transitive-import closure over rawlsing_next at head. Seeded from C4C3's five declared C4 layers my closure is exactly 21 modules and reproduces C4C3's list module for module, which independently validates C4C3's O1-C05 and P2X analysis. Adding the Route-B producer expands the closure to 23 modules, a delta of exactly two: rawlsing_next/pre553_route_b_production.py and rawlsing_next/pre553_carrier_execution.py. The second is clean: all seven of its imports are already inside C4C3's 21, and it contains no importlib, exec_module, spec_from_file_location, sys.modules, subprocess, os.system, os.popen, exec, eval, os.environ or duckdb. The only __import__ hit in the expanded closure is the stdlib literal __import__('json') in pre553_discovery_exact.py, which C4C3 already classified benign. Neither new module has any edge to an ee_p2x_* or fiabc_* module.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.conclusion: P2X_DARWIN_GATES_NOT_ON_C4_PATH survives the Route-B binding. The holding extends from C4C3's 21 modules to my independently derived 23. No repair is needed; the record should be updated to state 23.

additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.title: The Route-B producer's own test file lies outside the authoritative 55-test court
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.finding: rawlsing_next/tests/test_pre553_route_b_production.py carries 11 tests. C4A listed it in the C3 compatibility group, not the C3 surface group. It is therefore inside C4A's 25-file wider sweep (530 passed / 3 failed) but OUTSIDE C4C3's authoritative six-file / 55-test court. The fan-in excluded that wider sweep from the authoritative denominator, which was correct, but did not notice that the module it newly bound as the Route-B owner has no authoritative-denominator coverage.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.mitigation: The 11 tests did pass at C4A on this exact combined tree: the C3 subset was 76 passed / 3 failed over 10 files, and the 3 failures were in two other files (test_fiabc_lits_i_representation_authority.py once and test_fiabc_lm2_r1i_physical_native_hostile.py twice). So the Route-B producer is exercised and green at the combined tree, just not at the authoritative grain.

additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.title: LiTS oracle_document_sha256 carries no verification-status label and does not resolve in-repository
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.finding: The freeze carries LiTS oracle_document_sha256 = cb1c6ae6f9ddef15d41897451ac9f60208d4615ea60ddbeaef8874ba1000e3f4 in artifacts 02, 03, 04 and 05. I tested it and it is not a git object in this repository, so it cannot be resolved here. Unlike checkpoint_identity and canonical_closure_identity, it carries NO verification-status label, so it reads with the same apparent authority as the WVS oracle document digest, which I did resolve and verify.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.asymmetry_note: This is an inconsistency of labelling discipline inside a single freeze: one unresolvable digest is explicitly typed as a label, another unresolvable digest is not. I verified the WVS digest 9d11a480... against blob 9eecf801... and it matches exactly; the LiTS digest cb1c6ae6... has no such resolution available here.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.repair: Either resolve cb1c6ae6... against its actual oracle document and record the resolution, or type it explicitly as RECORDED_NOT_RESOLVED at this grain.

additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.title: D2P's explicit 24-over-18 authority disclosure to HQ was not carried forward
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.finding: D2P's requirements_on_HQ_at_fanin instructed in writing: note that the 24 AuthoritySnapshots materialise 18 distinct authority documents, six of them materialised once per governed_operations scope, and read '24' as 24 snapshot objects over 18 authorities, not 24 distinct authority documents. The fan-in repeated '24/24 AuthoritySnapshot objects' without carrying this interpretive caution forward.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.my_independent_confirmation: Counting 03_AUTHORITY_SNAPSHOT_CLOSURE.jsonl gives 24 rows and exactly 18 distinct authority_id values, confirming D2P's disclosure precisely.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.impact_assessment: The fan-in's 24/24 count is CORRECT at the object grain, so no number is wrong. What was lost is the caution against reading 24 snapshots as 24 distinct authorities, which would overstate governance-authority diversity.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.repair: Carry the 24-over-18 caveat forward into the final freeze record.

additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.title: RES-3 restatement omits the numpy 'ns' integer-arrival case
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.finding: The freeze's RES-3 states that numpy datetime64 unit selection changes D02 arrival typing, citing unit 'D' versus 's'. C4C3 probe D02-4 additionally measured that unit 'us' yields datetime.datetime and unit 'ns' yields a plain int (1207375628000000000), i.e. not a date at all.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.impact_assessment: RES-3's law is 'bounded by the frozen numpy 2.4.6; a different numpy voids the O1-C04 arrival-typing binding', which already covers the ns case. So this is a description gap, not a bound gap. No behaviour changes.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.repair: Extend the RES-3 statement to note that unit 'ns' produces a non-date integer arrival, which is a fail-closed outcome rather than a supported carrier.

additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.title: The qualified O1-C05 execution surface is not durable and not repository-reconstructible
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.finding: Four facts combine. (a) I confirmed there is no repository dependency lock of any kind: no requirements*.txt, constraints*.txt, uv.lock, poetry.lock, Pipfile, pyproject.toml, setup.py, setup.cfg, pytest.ini, tox.ini or conftest.py. (b) C4C3's own environment lock records the venv as living in a per-session temporary directory and states in terms that it is NOT durable and NOT reproducible from that path alone. (c) I checked the qualified base interpreter at LOCAL_COURTS/tooling/python/cpython-3.11.3-macos-x86_64-none/ and it is NOT committed to the repository; that path has zero tracked files. Only a 32-hex-character (16-byte) prefix of its SHA-256 is recorded. (d) C4C3 discloses that the resolve was performed against live package indexes on 2026-10-02 and that a future re-resolve could select a different narwhals, which would change the freeze hash.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.net_assessment: The execution-surface identifier is a label whose concrete backing artifacts are partly non-durable. The freeze is still a valid specification of the surface; it is not a guarantee that the surface can be reconstructed from the repository alone.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.why_this_does_not_block_the_freeze: O1-C05's stage is BEFORE_FIRST_GOVERNED_SOURCE_EXECUTION, and artifact 06's validity_and_invalidation already requires STOP and a new qualification on any pyreadstat/pandas/numpy/CPython/OS/architecture/option/lane change. That invalidation law is the correct control and it is present.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.required_before_live_execution: Either preserve the exact qualified venv durably and record a full (not 16-byte-prefix) interpreter digest, or re-create the environment from the recorded reproduce_command and re-qualify at the claimed grade before the governed run. Do not rely on a label.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.fanin_disclosure_comparison: The fan-in recorded only (a) as a one-line ADVISORY and disclosed none of (b), (c) or (d). This is the one place where the fan-in's disclosure was materially thinner than the underlying situation.

additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.title: narwhals appears in the freeze's own pip_freeze but not in its invalidating-conditions list
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.finding: narwhals 2.26.0 is present in the frozen pip_freeze list and is the one unpinned transitive arrival, pulled by pyarrow 25.0.1. Artifact 06's validity_and_invalidation.invalidating_conditions lists pyreadstat, pandas, numpy, CPython, OS/architecture, reader options and lane assignment, but not narwhals. C4C3 states that a re-resolve selecting a different narwhals would change the freeze hash.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.impact_assessment: C4C3 resolves the substance correctly: narwhals is off the C4 import closure, absent from the authoritative court, and cannot alter the qualification result. I independently confirmed no module in the 23-module closure imports it. So the qualification result is robust and only the hash moves.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.repair: Add a note that a narwhals re-resolution changes the freeze hash but not the qualification result, so it is a hash change rather than a re-qualification trigger.

additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.title: Per-source read-limit slots from C4B's warrant template are absent from the warrant candidate
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.finding: C4B's template carries, for each of the seven fresh-read sources, a source_access_accounting block with seven placeholders: full_file_sha256_passes = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT; path_opens = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT_AND_BASIS; decoder_invocations = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT; metadata_header_reads = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT; selected_reads = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT_AND_CONFIG; full_reads = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT_AND_CONFIG; retries = REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT_AND_REASON. Four of the seven carry an extra qualifier: path_opens requires a stated basis, selected_reads and full_reads a stated config, retries a stated reason. The fan-in's warrant candidate replaced this with one global access_accounting_instrumentation_bound account list. The per-source slots are gone from the warrant instrument.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.why_it_matters: O1-C06 requires the warrant to bind operations/columns/read limits per source. Read limits are per-source quantities. The substantive law survives in artifact 07, but an executor holding only the warrant has no per-source read-limit field to comply with.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.required_repair: At issuance, restore the per-source source_access_accounting block for all seven sources with the seven exact-count slots and their basis/config requirements, populated or bound to the frozen expectations in artifact 07.

additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.title: A truncated digest sits in a machine-readable identity field
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.finding: Artifact 05 records later_standardization.T3_freeze_sha256 = "7dfb6...", an abbreviated prefix rather than a digest. The neighbouring fields in the same object, standard_oracle_identity and standard_oracle_document_sha256, are full 64-hex values, so the truncation is an internal inconsistency within one identity object. Omega-1 carries the full value 7dfb62362b983b92dee2774d862a46c0c0ce3ca2c3bb48850e0f400346936908, which itself does not resolve to any object in this repository.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.scope_note: I swept the whole fan-in packet for truncated forms. The only other occurrences are in prose fields: 00_COMMISSION.md, 00_RETURN-style narrative, and the law/note strings in artifacts 02 and 05, where an abbreviation is plainly rhetorical. This one is the only instance in a machine-readable identity field.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.impact_assessment: The field belongs to a WVS later-standardization record, not to the operative SRC35 oracle identity, so nothing load-bearing is affected. An abbreviated digest is not a valid identity and cannot be compared or verified.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.repair: Restore the full 64-hex digest and type it as recorded-not-resolved at this grain.

additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.title: Three denominators are mis-stated, always in the conservative direction
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.finding: Three bookkeeping inconsistencies. (a) Artifacts 00, 03 and 10 state 34 imported evidence files (9 C4B + 9 C4C3 + 16 D2P); the actual count at head is 36 (10 + 10 + 16), and artifact 01's own detail list correctly has 36 entries and artifact 09's V06 correctly says 36. (b) Artifact 09's V07 says artifacts_validated = 7; the packet contains 10 JSON artifacts and I parsed all 10 successfully. (c) Artifact 09's V01 says checked = 11 while citing artifact 01's pinned list, which has 13 entries.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.impact_assessment: Every discrepancy understates coverage and none overstates it. Nothing is missing: the actual imported set is 36 files and all 36 are present and blob-exact. There is no inflated claim anywhere in the packet.
additional_findings_identified_by_this_r.repair: Normalise 34 to 36, 7 to 10, and reconcile V01's count with the evidence it cites.
